newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat firms on short covering in Dec.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat firms on short covering in Dec.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures opened lower but firmed in early midsession dealings on short covering in the December contract by Cargill (CIS), traders said.

"Cargill came in as we were trading lower and bid for about 300,000 Dec. That's what stopped the bleeding and kind of turned the whole thing around," a trader said. "What we have heard is that Cargill is a major short in both Minneapolis and in Kansas City."
Traders in Kansas City reported earlier that CIS had come in bidding for one million bushels of Dec wheat.

At 1015 CST, MGE spring wheat was 1/4 cent lower to two cents higher, with Dec down 1/4 cent at $4.13. It hit an earlier intraday low at $4.09. MGE March spring wheat was 1-1/4 cents higher at $3.89-1/2.
Traders said Friday's short covering was supporting the Dec/March inverted spread, which traded early at 20 cents but had widened to 24 cents.

Wilson Trading reportedly bear-spread one million March/Dec at between 23 and 24 cents. Country Hedging bear-spread 500,000 March/Dec at 22 to 23 cents. Benson-Quinn bull-spread at least 700,000 Dec/March at 22 to 23 cents.
